Setting.Name: Frontend::Module###AgentNetworkSimulationAccess
Setting.Description: Administrator customer simulation access and environment bindings.

Hash.Item: Customer grants and Navis environment bindings
Grant customer analysis access and configure environment graphs

Setting.Name: CustomerFrontend::Module###CustomerNetworkSimulation
Setting.Description: Entitled customer network workspace. CMDB detail access and separately configured simulation authorization are enforced in the backend.

Hash.Item: Explore application systems and network paths
Explore permitted systems and analyze connections

Setting.Name: TESSERA::CustomerNetworkSimulation::Enabled
Setting.Description: Enable customer-originated remote simulation. Local CMDB endpoint exploration still requires CMDB read entitlement.

Setting.Name: TESSERA::CustomerNetworkSimulation::AllowedCustomerUsers
Setting.Description: Explicit customer account logins authorized to request remote simulation, independently of CMDB read permission. No wildcard or company matching.

Setting.Name: TESSERA::CustomerNetworkSimulation::Bindings
Setting.Description: JSON object keyed by active Environment GovernanceObject ID. Each value contains WebserviceID, BuildID and Namespace for a configured Navis connection and completed graph. No agent ActorID is used.
